attribute.name: name

parameter.name: name
parameter.docString:
Name of the rule. Important for gitops since it becomes part of
the target manifest file name in the gitops_path directory.

parameter.name: cluster
parameter.docString: Target Kubernetes cluster name. Defaults to "dev".

parameter.name: user
parameter.docString:
Kubernetes user for authentication. Defaults to "{BUILD_USER}"
which is substituted at runtime.

parameter.name: namespace
parameter.docString:
Target Kubernetes namespace. Required when gitops=True.
Defaults to "{BUILD_USER}" when gitops=False.

parameter.name: configmaps_srcs
parameter.docString: List of source files for generating ConfigMaps.

parameter.name: secrets_srcs
parameter.docString: List of source files for generating Secrets.

parameter.name: configmaps_renaming
parameter.docString:
ConfigMap renaming policy. Can be None (no renaming)
or "hash" (append content hash to names).

parameter.name: manifests
parameter.docString:
List of Kubernetes manifest files. Defaults to all .yaml and
.yaml.tpl files in the package via glob.

parameter.name: name_prefix
parameter.docString: Prefix to add to all resource names via kustomize.

parameter.name: name_suffix
parameter.docString: Suffix to add to all resource names via kustomize.

parameter.name: prefix_suffix_app_labels
parameter.docString:
If True, applies kustomize configuration to
modify "app" labels in Deployments when name_prefix or name_suffix
is applied.

parameter.name: patches
parameter.docString: List of kustomize patches to apply to the manifests.

parameter.name: image_name_patches
parameter.docString: Dict mapping original image names to new image names.

parameter.name: image_tag_patches
parameter.docString: Dict mapping image names to new tags.

parameter.name: substitutions
parameter.docString:
Dict of template parameter substitutions. CLUSTER and
NAMESPACE parameters are added automatically and should not be
included.

parameter.name: configurations
parameter.docString: List of additional kustomize configuration files.

parameter.name: common_labels
parameter.docString:
Dict of labels to apply to all Kubernetes objects.
See kustomize commonLabels documentation.

parameter.name: common_annotations
parameter.docString:
Dict of annotations to apply to all Kubernetes
objects. See kustomize commonAnnotations documentation.

parameter.name: deps
parameter.docString: List of dependency targets.

parameter.name: deps_aliases
parameter.docString: Dict mapping aliases to dependency targets.

parameter.name: images
parameter.docString: List of container image targets to include in the deployment.

parameter.name: objects
parameter.docString: List of additional Kubernetes objects to include.

parameter.name: gitops
parameter.docString:
If True, creates a gitops target for GitOps workflow. Set to
False to work with individual namespaces. Automatically set to
False if namespace is "{BUILD_USER}".

parameter.name: gitops_path
parameter.docString: Directory path for gitops manifests. Defaults to "cloud".

parameter.name: deployment_branch
parameter.docString: Git branch for deployments. If None, uses default.

parameter.name: release_branch_prefix
parameter.docString: Prefix for release branches. Defaults to "main".

parameter.name: start_tag
parameter.docString: Opening delimiter for template substitutions. Defaults to "{{".

parameter.name: end_tag
parameter.docString: Closing delimiter for template substitutions. Defaults to "}}".

parameter.name: tags
parameter.docString: List of tags to apply to all generated targets.

parameter.name: visibility
parameter.docString: Visibility specification for generated targets.

parameter.name: verify_images
parameter.docString: Whether or not to fail if a Bazel image could not be resolved.

funcInfo.docString:
Generates Kubernetes deployment targets with optional GitOps support.

This macro creates kustomization targets and kubectl binaries for deploying
Kubernetes manifests. When gitops is enabled, it also creates a gitops target
for managing deployments through a GitOps workflow.
